scripts.build:web: mkdir -p www && cp index.html login.html booking.html dashboard.html results.html style.css script.js sw.js logo.ico logo.png www/ && cp -r assets www/
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run build:web && npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
